question.text: The standard Gibbs energy change at 300 K for the reaction <math><mn>2</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi><mo>⇌</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">B</mi><mo>+</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi></math> is 2494.2 J. At a given time, the composition of the reaction mixture is <math><mfenced close="]" open="[" separators="|"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi></mrow></mfenced><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></mfrac><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><mfenced close="]" open="[" separators="|"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">B</mi></mrow></mfenced><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn></math> and <math><mfenced close="]" open="[" separators="|"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi></mrow></mfenced><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></mfrac></math> . The reaction proceeds in the: <math><mo>[</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">R</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>8.314</mn><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">J</mi></mrow><mo>/</mo><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">K</mi><mo>-</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">o</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><mi mathvariant="normal">e</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>2.718</mn><mo>] </mo></mrow></mrow></math> {Given antilog (-0.44)=0.36}

solution.text:
Δ G ∘ = - RT ln K C

2494.2 = - 8.314 × 300 ln K C

2494.2 = - 8.314 × 300 × 2.303 log K C

- 2494.2 2.303 × 300 × 8.314 = - 0.44 = log K C

log KC=-0.44

K C = 0.36

Q=[B][C][A]2=2×12122=4

Q>KC, reaction will shift in reverse direction.
